_source: Derived from the community can-i-take-over-xyz project (https://github.com/EdOverflow/can-i-take-over-xyz), services listed as vulnerable with an HTTP body fingerprint. NXDOMAIN-only services are excluded: this detector works from HTTP responses.
_comment: DETECTION ONLY. A match means the DNS record points at an unclaimed third-party resource; Paddock never claims it. fingerprint_text is a case-insensitive body substring and is authoritative; http_status is informational unless no text is given.
